subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: Supply Chain Weaponization
description: A quick win: understand Supply Chain Weaponization.

hook.text: China controls 80% of rare earth processing. Restricting exports would cripple defense and tech industries.

buildup.text: Countries increasingly use supply chain dominance as a geopolitical weapon—restricting exports to gain leverage.

discovery.text: Semiconductor controls, energy embargoes, and mineral restrictions are all forms of supply chain weaponization.

twist.text: Dependency on a single country for critical inputs gives that country enormous political power.

climax.text: The US CHIPS Act and EU Critical Raw Materials Act aim to reduce dangerous dependencies through reshoring.

punchline.text: When supply chains become weapons, independence becomes strategy.

quiz.question: What is supply chain weaponization?
options: Using supply dominance as geopolitical leverage
